description: React component for the Results Page of a web application, displaying persisted run history, summaries, and export options for data validation and anomaly detection runs.

methods.name: formatDateTime
methods.description: Formats ISO date strings into localized date-time strings, or returns a placeholder if invalid.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Converts byte counts into human-readable strings with appropriate units.

methods.name: typeLabel
methods.description: Maps internal run type identifiers to user-friendly labels.

methods.name: statusStyle
methods.description: Returns style object based on run status for visual indication.

methods.name: asNumberMaybe
methods.description: Attempts to parse a value as a finite number, returning null if not possible.

methods.name: extractAnomaliesFlaggedCount
methods.description: Extracts the count of flagged anomalies from a run summary, handling various possible key names.

methods.name: formatPct
methods.description: Formats a finite number as a percentage string.

methods.name: kpiDeltaText
methods.description: Generates a textual summary of offline/mock run counts versus total.
